name: _weight_norm
description: Representative schema: aten::_weight_norm(Tensor v, Tensor g, int dim=0) -> Tensor. Produces a newly allocated weight normalized along the selected first or last dimension without mutating its inputs. Tests cover supported floating dtypes, first/last dimensions, representative ranks, noncontiguous layout, zero norms, output metadata, gradients for v and g, and rejected integer or float64 inputs.
